capabilities: Set light and dark background colors
Customize internal, external, and unresolved link colors
Adjust font size, line height, and paragraph spacing
Configure per-heading color, size, and weight for H1-H6
Style blockquotes, code blocks, tags, lists, and dividers
disambiguation: Not an installable theme; it adds settings controls for colors and typography, mainly for the default theme.
extras: Installed via BRAT as a beta plugin and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns settings may not work with community themes or conflicting CSS snippets.
problem: Customizing colors, text sizing, and spacing in Obsidian normally requires writing CSS snippets, which many users cannot do.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from the Obsidian community plugins

summary: Appearance settings panel that changes background colors, link colors, typography, and element styling without writing CSS snippets.
